ABOUT_US.HISTORY_TITLE: More than 10 years being your company
ABOUT_US.HISTORY_TEXT: We were born with the purpose of connecting the community through faith. What began as a small local project is now a signal that reaches thousands of people, offering programming rich in values, inspiring music, and messages that transform lives.
ABOUT_US.MISSION_TEXT: Spread the message of hope through excellent communication, being a firm bridge between the community and Christian values for the spiritual strengthening of every listener.
ABOUT_US.VISION_TEXT: Establish ourselves as the leading station in broadcasting spiritual and social content in the region, constantly innovating our platforms to reach new generations.
